source.path: architecture/phase 52 cross domaiin and engineering sections

capabilities.name: Universal entity, relationship, state, event, observation, and reality model
capabilities.decision: Extend Phase 33 contracts only after ownership review; do not create a Phase 52 owner.

capabilities.name: Physical object/device identity, enrollment, adapters, and connection codes
capabilities.decision: Candidate extension of Phase 15 and Phase 33; no new phase until device identity boundary and security model are proven.

capabilities.name: Telemetry normalization, physical health, anomaly detection, and predictive maintenance
capabilities.decision: Reconcile as Phase 15 hardware and Phase 18 analytics extensions.

capabilities.name: Spatial, geographic, building, room, energy, transport, and movement intelligence
capabilities.decision: Candidate capability; require spatial ontology, tenancy, retention, and geospatial evidence before phase proposal.

capabilities.name: Reality observer, memory, reasoning, prediction, action, monitoring, and organization-brain agents
capabilities.decision: Use existing agent and AI ownership; do not create a second agent society.

capabilities.name: Runtime factory, domain packages, generated workflows, agents, and dynamic workspaces
capabilities.decision: Reconcile against runtime/workspace ownership; no runtime generator implementation.

capabilities.name: Digital reality twins, temporal state, causal graphs, interventions, counterfactuals, and simulation
capabilities.decision: Keep candidate work behind D4/D5 ownership decisions.

capabilities.name: Universal CoreObject contracts for identity, tenant, entity, event, context, policy, authority, agent, memory, tool, model, workflow, action, evidence, and simulation
capabilities.decision: Compare with existing typed contracts; do not introduce a parallel universal object model.

capabilities.name: Event kernel, streams, processing, replay, event sourcing, routing, policy, and observability
capabilities.decision: Extend Phase 05 event ownership; do not create a new event service.

capabilities.name: Evidence, provenance, confidence, audit history, and epistemic distinction
capabilities.decision: Candidate control-plane capability; require evidence identity, revocation, staleness, and persistence contract.

capabilities.name: Experience constitution, stable interfaces, workspace compiler, proposal, diff, approval, and rollback
capabilities.decision: Extend workspace and experience ownership; preserve governed-change constraints.

capabilities.name: Observability, reliability, self-healing, scaling, economics, and disaster recovery
capabilities.decision: Do not claim operational readiness without deployed telemetry and recovery evidence.

capabilities.name: Scholar as first generated/runtime-instantiated domain
capabilities.decision: Keep education semantics in runtime-001; do not move them into universal phases.

rule: A candidate becomes a phase only after unique purpose, ownership, boundaries, contracts, schemas, runtime, security, failure, evidence, verification, conformance, and evolution are proven.
